inside_hollywood_right.notes: In the venue plan: standing at y -34 in the east aisle, looking north between the column rows x 15.59 and 22.17 to the north wall. Round satin-aluminium spiral ducts with a bright streak along the top, aluminium dome pendants, loop-pile carpet with the purple runner, columns with grime at the foot and a thin warm haze toward the end wall. Off: the plan's 0.7 m columns put the column bases higher than the photo shows, and the real duct clutter is denser.

hollywood_booth_closeup_left.notes: Dark, blue and contrasty like the photo: black ceiling with round silver ducts and the white panel top right, warm oak slats plank by plank, crisp mirrored ASML letters, a neutral white booth wall and the plan column on the right. Which bay the booth is in is a guess (column -3.8, -7.77); most of the background is behind the three people.

inside_hollywood_w_booths.notes: Three high tables (one behind the woman), the JetBrains booth front on the y -20.75 column row, a fine grey-mauve loop-pile carpet (fleck, faint rows, soft variation) and the orange bar. Shot with the 24-70 at about 55 mm, not the 85: with the 85 the camera would stand inside a wall of the plan. The robot and people are left out.
